message.content:
An editorial illustration features a central composite object: a giant gavel where the head is a transparent glass vial. The vial has a dark grey cap and a white label featuring a small circular logo of a red bull’s head. A large hand with reddish-orange skin, emerging from a bright red sleeve, grips the clear, tapered handle of this gavel-vial.

Below the descending gavel, a comparatively small man with dark hair and glasses wears a white long-sleeved shirt and black trousers. He is captured in a running pose, looking upward over his shoulder with his hands raised. The background consists of a dark teal gradient transitioning to a hazy light grey surface at the bottom.

Large white block letters at the top spell "TEMPO." At the bottom right, bold black text reads "HALAL-HARAM CUAN VAKSIN." Smaller text blocks include "Tersudut Wabah Mulut dan Kuku H.68" and "Dagang Opini Auditor BPK H.58." A barcode and QR code are located in the upper right corner next to the date "16-22 MEI 2022." Smaller Indonesian text is visible at the bottom.
